results.title: Father Tree
results.overview: When a young woman returns to care for her ailing father, she discovers that his illness is slowly transforming him into a tree. As his metamorphosis unfolds, she learns to nurture him in his new form, confront their complicated bond, and find an unexpected path toward reconciliation, love, and acceptance.

results.title: Personal Whore(or): Ho Ho Ho
results.overview: As Flynn (Oliver Chally) and Leaf (Marissa Margolin) seek relief from their traumatic experience with The Watcher, they go to an Anti-Christmas party to loosen up and blow off some steam. This party, hosted by the rebellious daughter of Santa Clause (Greta Van Eck), takes a wicked turn as someone is mysteriously murdered. Flynn, once again, must solve the mystery, and get the party goers home for the Holidays.

results.title: From Gaming to Murder: The Killing of Breck Bednar
results.original_title: From Gaming to Murder: The Killing of Breck Bednar
results.overview: Told by Breck Bednar's family and friends, this powerful series reveals how the innocent world of an online gaming group became the stalking ground of a predator. Lewis Daynes created a fantasy life of a tech millionaire in order to isolate and groom 14-year-old Breck. Despite Breck's parents' desperate efforts to protect him, Daynes lured Breck to his murder with the most cynical of lies.

results.title: Frosty Nights, Santa Fights
results.overview: The Clausverse faces danger when Jack Frost seeks revenge against Santa Claus for the imprisonment of his father, Sam. Jack begins to turn traditional Christmas into an AI cold celebration, so Santa fights Jack from taking over Christmas.

results.title: Ray Comfort's Inferno
results.overview: A found footage movie collage of various Hells throughout Christian cinema. It is tied together and wrapped around with clips of Ray Comfort. A mediation on the concept and presentation of hell with the help of special guest Mr. Bean.

results.title: Anti-Princesas
results.overview: At the Neza-Bordo prison, ten incarcerated women take part in a theater workshop led by La Cana. Through rehearsals, the stage becomes a space to name violence, revisit their own stories and recover a voice that was silenced for years.  Anti-Princesas follows this process up to the final performance in front of their families, interweaving the theater work with the participants' testimonies. Their accounts reveal stories marked by gender-based violence, abusive relationships, long periods without a sentence, and a justice system that often fails to effectively apply the gender perspective set out in Mexican law.  More than a film about prison, Anti-Princesas is a collective portrait of ten women who, from confinement, find in theater a form of resistance, expression and freedom.

results.title: República dos Laranjas
results.overview: Remember the episode where Fábio Porchat revealed the connections between Flávio Bolsonaro, Daniel Vorcaro, and Banco Master? Well, he’s back.  And this time, the story is even more scandalous. What appeared to be a close-knit brotherhood was, in fact, a web of alleged partnerships, business dealings, and financial ties—involving far more people than we mentioned last time.  Money hidden in books, offshore accounts, private jets, mansions, suspected fraud targeting INSS (social security) pensioners, parties involving trafficked women, and even a Supreme Federal Court justice. In this episode, Fábio Porchat connects the dots of an elaborate network of "straw men"—a scheme involving Willer Tomaz, Daniel Vorcaro, and Kassio Nunes Marques, leading all the way to presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. On paper, no one seems to own anything. But who is really behind it all?  And what will become of these investigations if Flávio Bolsonaro reaches the presidency?

results.title: Figure it out yourselves!
results.overview: Banana and Snail embark on a cross-country road trip to a destination that holds deep personal significance for Banana. But as the miles pass and their journey unfolds, Banana refuses to reveal the meaning behind their destination, leaving Snail to wonder what secrets lie at the end of the road.

results.title: Bot Love

results.original_title: John le Carré: A New Life
